response.markdown_report:
At 20% progress, select **bounded curriculum weighting of the existing 16 negatives**, with diagnostic coverage restored before interpreting its effects. This is a proposed experiment; no new performance is claimed.

**Insights from the starting point.** (1) The supplied multi-negative experiment scored 0.5900 versus the cold start’s 0.5425. This motivates retaining its direction, but does not isolate which intervention helped. (2) Current margin diagnostics inspected zero batches. This establishes missing measurement coverage, not poor separation or absent production masks. (3) Users report broad associations displacing specific matches and recommendations lacking identifiable relevance. Interaction-based discrimination may address both indirectly; it cannot infer equipment compatibility or ownership.

**Insights from related work.** (1) Sampling comparisons support testing adaptive hardness, while warning that sampling choices trade accuracy against item exposure [sampling study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17276). Transfer to this benchmark remains unverified. (2) Joint text learning offers a route toward specific item connections, but Recformer uses pretrained initialization [Recformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13731). A small encoder trained from scratch is a separate hypothesis. (3) Temporal representations distinguish elapsed time from calendar trends [TemProxRec](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.09784). Omitted sensitivity outcomes provide no evidence for imposing recency decay here.

The framework separates **competition** through loss weighting, **identification** through text, and **context** through temporal features. Measurement coverage and checkpoint consistency span all three directions.

Scores below are originality/potential/user alignment/model alignment/difficulty; higher difficulty means harder implementation. Each assessment includes a benefit (+) and limitation (−).

| Atomic idea | Assessments |
|---|---|
| Bounded curriculum CE | O 3: +controlled combination, −established mechanism; P 7: +cheap extension, −false negatives; U 6: +specific discrimination, −indirect relevance; M 5: +restores measured coverage, −no observed separation deficit; D 4: +local loss change, −diagnostic integration |
| Joint title residual | O 4: +constrained adaptation, −existing text fusion; P 7: +identification signal, −sparse titles; U 8: +specific connections, −cannot establish usefulness; M 4: +auditable features, −no diagnosed text deficit; D 6: +simple pooling, −predictor changes |
| Learned time-gap bias | O 3: +benchmark adaptation, −known temporal modeling; P 6: +occasion sensitivity, −timestamp noise; U 7: +current-interest hypothesis, −no intent labels; M 3: +measurable sensitivity, −numerical evidence omitted; D 6: +small parameter count, −timestamp interfaces |

For the selected idea, warm up with uniform CE, then gradually redistribute a bounded fraction of negative weight toward higher-scoring candidates from the **same K=16 set**. Preserve total negative weight and detach weighting gradients. Explicitly target broad adjacent-item substitutions and weakly supported recommendations, without claiming either is resolved. Restore valid masked-target diagnostic batches to address the observed measurement failure. Compare against uniform K=16 using fixed macro validation HR@10; never combine their predictions.

idea.description: Test bounded, gradually introduced weighting of the same 16 uniformly sampled negatives inside the supplied corrected BERT4Rec. Train exactly one independent model per category. Pair the loss experiment with restoration of measured masked-target diagnostic coverage, treating that restoration as instrumentation rather than an accuracy improvement.
idea.motivation: The supplied prior multi-negative experiment is promising contextual evidence, while current diagnostics provide no measured separation results. The intervention hypothesizes that moderately emphasizing confusing alternatives will reduce broadly related items displacing stronger contextual matches and recommendations with weak identifiable connections to history. These are two explicit user-facing targets, not established benefits. The observed model-facing failure addressed directly is zero inspected diagnostic batches; harmful embedding collapse, inadequate convergence and excessive recency dependence are not established.
idea.implementation_notes:
Modify the supplied baseline rather than reconstructing unavailable source. First audit its objective, K, negative eligibility and replacement policy, masking, terminal allocation, reductions, optimizer and checkpoint rules. If the actual starting configuration is not uniform candidate CE with K=16, identify the resulting combined intervention explicitly. Retain a separately trained uniform-K=16 comparison only when budget permits; do not read other trials or reuse their checkpoints.

Declare a modest schedule before validation: alpha_e = 0.25 * clamp((e - 20) / 40, 0, 1), with epochs numbered from zero. For each valid target and its unchanged 16 negative logits, compute r_j = stop_gradient(softmax(n_j)); w_j = (1-alpha_e) + alpha_e*16*r_j. Thus weights sum to 16 and remain at least 0.75. Optimize logsumexp([p, n_1+log(w_1), ..., n_16+log(w_16)])-p with the baseline across-target reduction. At alpha=0 this is ordinary candidate CE. This is a weighted candidate-ranking objective, not unbiased full-catalog likelihood; its bounded weights do not establish negative-label correctness. Preserve candidate multiplicities under the audited sampling policy. Do not silently add deduplication or history exclusions. Keep eligibility limited to training information and exclude positive, PAD and MASK according to the documented policy. No separate mining model or larger scoring pool is introduced.

Use the same purpose-separated seed-42 RNG design in both matched configurations if matching samples is implemented; distinguish any resulting RNG change from the untouched host baseline. Preserve architecture, corruption, endpoint allocation, optimizer, clipping and checkpoint policy so weighting is the primary intervention. No text or temporal changes belong in this trial.

Restore DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) coverage using an independent disposable loader from the family-specific sampler. Diagnostic tuples remain (None, sequence, positive, negative), all B x L, with the existing one-negative semantics. Retain diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis), metrics and metric_definitions. Record inspected batches, valid reserved-mask target counts and reasons for unavailable quantities. Report measured margins and negative-beats-positive rates; avoid interpreting logit-scale changes as ranking improvements. Optionally record weight concentration from detached production loss inputs. Bounded explicit consumed-record captures can support pipeline auditing, but their absence remains unavailable. They do not certify all training steps. Do not claim checkpoint/predictor parity without fresh-process verification.

Keep view.model as the actual nn.Module and preserve item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data and review_data. Use only histories, titles, descriptions and observed timestamps; unavailable review text, ratings, item categories/prices/stores and simulator traits are excluded.

Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], supplied splits, all four category routes, single-GPU execution, maximum 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per epoch. Respect the SASREC_EPOCHS=200 environment default. Write artifacts beneath the trial directory. Training, diagnostics, failures and comparisons all consume the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget; concurrency does not reduce summed GPU cost.

Keep bidirectional BERT4Rec with reserved-mask training and appended-mask inference. Supervised target occurrences remain hidden; never introduce visible shifted targets. Retain the last L-1 context events, append MASK, left-pad and read the greatest nonpadding index, never count-1. Each category loads exactly one independently trained checkpoint. Preserve the embedded predictor writer and its configuration/mappings; no averaging, score fusion or auxiliary fitted scorer is permitted.

Select solely by the pinned four-category macro validation HR@10, preserving host users, candidates, schedule and selection rules. Report supplied per-category and macro results without fabricating uncertainty or full-catalog improvements. The twenty-user simulator can provide qualitative evidence only if actually executed. This input contains no baseline source, so these are implementable equations and integration requirements, not a verified executable train.py replacement.
idea.pseudocode:
Audit supplied corrected BERT4Rec and declare comparison and schedule.
Preserve preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42.
For each required category:
    Initialize one independent supplied BERT4Rec.
    For epoch e in range(at_most_200):
        alpha = 0.25 * clamp((e - 20) / 40, 0, 1)
        For exactly 200 batches:
            Sample original windows and apply unchanged reserved-mask corruption.
            Encode sequence with model.log2feats(sequence).
            Gather features only at valid supervised masked positions.
            Sample K=16 negatives using the declared unchanged eligibility policy.
            Compute positive logits p and negative logits n with predict_score.
            r = softmax(n.detach(), dim=-1)
            w = (1 - alpha) + alpha * 16 * r
            per_target_loss = logsumexp(concat(p, n + log(w))) - p
            Apply unchanged across-target reduction and optimizer procedure.
        Apply unchanged checkpoint-selection procedure.
    Save exactly one selected checkpoint and matching configuration.
    Run independent fixed diagnostic batches; return measured metrics and definitions.
Emit matching predictor with all four category routes.
At inference, load one category checkpoint; append MASK after retained history.
Read the greatest nonpadding position and score real candidates.
Compare host macro validation HR@10 against a separate uniform-K=16 configuration.
Never combine checkpoints or predictions.

originality.positive: Provides a narrowly controlled, bounded weighting extension to the existing multi-negative BERT4Rec experiment.
originality.negative: Curriculum weighting and score-dependent emphasis are established techniques; the contribution is experimental specificity rather than a new model class.

future_potential.positive: Requires no additional mining forward passes and can inform later sampling research within one jointly trained BERT4Rec.
future_potential.negative: Unobserved items remain uncertain negatives, and sampled-validation gains may not improve full-catalog usefulness.

code_difficulty.positive: The core intervention is a localized stable loss calculation with unchanged inference architecture.
code_difficulty.negative: Reliable comparison still requires baseline auditing, diagnostic-loader integration, runtime accounting and checkpoint/predictor verification.

related_work.title: BERT4Rec: Sequential Recommendation with Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer
contributions: Provides the bidirectional masked-item backbone and rationale for hiding supervised targets.
limitations: Does not establish benefits from the proposed bounded negative weighting under the pinned Amazon benchmark.

related_work.title: Sequential-recommendation negative-sampling study supplied in the search results
contributions: The supplied summary compares multiple negative-sampling strategies and reports accuracy/exposure trade-offs.
limitations: Does not establish a matched-K, matched-compute BERT4Rec improvement for the proposed weighting rule.

related_work.title: Recformer
contributions: Supports investigating jointly learned text-based sequential representations.
limitations: Uses pretrained Longformer initialization, which is unsuitable for direct adoption under this task's restrictions.

related_work.title: TemProxRec
contributions: Distinguishes absolute and relative temporal information in sequential recommendation.
limitations: Combines temporal modeling with other mechanisms and does not isolate an expected gain for this benchmark.
